stemMd: Which conclusion is best supported by the shopkeeper’s changed behaviour?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every borrower eventually bought a tool.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The lending scheme and local retail could complement each other.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Tool lending always harms private businesses.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The shopkeeper lost all income from tool sales.

explanationMd: The shopkeeper moved from opposition to offering demonstrations while shop sales remained stable. This supports the possibility that borrowing and retail support each other. It does not establish that every borrower bought equipment or that the relationship is universal.

distractorRationale.a: The passage does not quantify later purchases.
distractorRationale.d: This case suggests a compatible relationship.
